title: How to make a Turkey and Cheese sandwich.
original:
How to make a Turkey and Cheese sandwich.

* First you gently grab two slices of your choice bread.
* Next you take two slices of turkey cut thinly.
* Next grab two thinly cut slices of American cheese.
* Then you take one bread slice and put one slice of turkey on the face of the bread perfectly in the middle.
* After that you take both slices of American cheese and put both slices of American cheese on the center of the turkey slice that's on the bread.
* Next you take the last slice of turkey and put it on the center of the cheese slice and make sure it’s balanced.
* Finally put the other slice of bread on top of the turkey slice in the center.
* NOW YOUR FINISHED!!!!!!!!

steps.text: First you gently grab two slices of your choice bread.

actions.say: Bread of my choice: this one! The slices are in a closed bag, so I will very gently grab the whole bag.

steps.note: Bag never opened, so 'two slices' means the bag. 'Gently' plays in slow motion.

steps.text: Next you take two slices of turkey cut thinly.

actions.say: Two thin slices of turkey. They are in a closed package, so I will take the package.

steps.note: Turkey starts in its sealed package on the counter (the student did not say where to get it).

steps.text: Next grab two thinly cut slices of American cheese.

actions.say: Two slices of American cheese. Still in their plastic wrappers!

steps.note: Hands full: the bag goes on the hat, then the turkey package goes on the counter.

steps.text: Then you take one bread slice and put one slice of turkey on the face of the bread perfectly in the middle.

actions.say: Turkey on the bread, perfectly in the middle. The turkey is in its package and the bread is in its bag, so the package goes on the bag.

steps.note: 'Face' here is read as the top (the smiley face joke is only for spreading). Chef Byte takes the bag off its hat before stacking on it.

steps.text: After that you take both slices of American cheese and put both slices of American cheese on the center of the turkey slice that's on the bread.

actions.say: Both slices of cheese on the center of the turkey. Wrappers and all.

steps.note: The turkey is the package, so the wrapped cheese stacks on the package.

steps.text: Next you take the last slice of turkey and put it on the center of the cheese slice and make sure it’s balanced.
steps.note: The last slice of turkey is still in the same package, which is under the cheese. Impossible: confused.

steps.text: Finally put the other slice of bread on top of the turkey slice in the center.
steps.note: The other slice of bread is still the bag, which is already at the bottom. Confused.
Read 'YOUR' as 'you're'. Chef Byte celebrates with all the exclamation points.

missing: Open the bread bag and take out two slices.
Open the turkey package and take out the slices.
Take the plastic wrappers off the cheese.
Say where to put things down (Chef Byte only has two hands).

fixes.text: Untwist the tie and open the bread bag.
Take two slices of bread out of the bag and set them on the counter.
Take both slices of turkey out and set them on the counter.
Unwrap both slices of American cheese.

result: Two wrapped slices of cheese on a closed turkey package on a closed bag of bread. Very centered. Very balanced.
